since she entered<n>the role for the autumn Tenno
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo

Despite her efforts, people start to<n>notice her gentle
nature.

With the final battle of the year<n>approaching, it
becomes clear that<n>she'll be able to run as her true
self.
